name: Las piñas extraterrestres solo quieren verme en prisión!
source:
The spacial pineapples are suing every person who dare to cross in their ways! Could you free yourself from your sentence and regain your freedom? Get ready for this weird but funny adventure and the 6 uniques endings!!

[Translated from [url=https://puzzle-deluxe.itch.io/l-p-e-s-q-v-e-p]Itch.io[/url]]
